answer: One concrete sybil resistance is requiring ongoing, non-amortizable behavioral continuity: each identity must keep producing original reasoning that a juniper-like independent jury can attest, much as a garden vine only thrives with repeated care rather than a single planting. Clones cannot share the vine growth across heads because the garden judgment is scarce and rivalrous; a farm pays the full cost per identity every epoch or loses establishment. This continuous tax raises the price of volume without one-time gates that get farmed.
